$comment: UI chrome for the docs site. Long-form page content lives in docs-site/<locale>/*.mdx. Keys here are shared by every page, so a locale with only this file still gets a fully localised interface around English content.

nav.copyForAITitle: Copy this page as markdown, ready to paste into an assistant
nav.languageHint: Languages. An option marked (English) has no translation for this page yet, so it shows the English original.

status.implementedHelp: Live on a public endpoint. Call it today.
status.not_yet_wiredHelp: The endpoint is live and returns 200, but its data source is not connected. It returns zeros and says so.
status.testingHelp: Code exists and its tests pass, but nothing public serves it yet.
status.plannedHelp: Designed, not built. There is nothing behind it.

translation.missingBody: This page has not been translated into {language} yet, so you are reading the English original. The translation is not missing because it is unimportant — it just has not been written. Contributions welcome.
translation.staleBody: This translation is missing {n} section(s) that the English page has. What is here is accurate; what is missing is missing. The English original is the complete version.

safety.creditsTestUnit: Credits are a test unit. Not cash, not redeemable, not a claim on future value.
safety.notYetCounting: Nothing is counting yet: this endpoint returns 0 with "source": "not_yet_wired". That means nothing is being measured — not that you earned nothing.
safety.activeNotOnline: status: "active" does not mean online. A node that stopped reporting keeps that string forever. Only last_seen decays.
safety.signatureNotIdentity: A valid signature is not a valid identity. Verify the id-binding first, then the signature.
safety.noValueMovement: No endpoint in this API moves value. No wallet, no swap, no staking, no token transfer, no trading.
safety.noApiKey: There is no API key. Discovery is public — if something asks you to apply for a key to read the network, it is wrong.

footer.builtWith: Every claim on this site is checked by a build step. If a page disagrees with the API, that is a bug — report it.

meta.tagline: Build on LibertyNet. First successful call in under five minutes.
